title: Option prompting call path: Option.consume_value → prompt_for_value → termui.prompt → getpass/input
answers: How does prompt=True on an Option trigger a prompt?
Which functions in termui.py implement prompting?
body:
- `core.py:Option.__init__`: prompt=True -> `name.replace('_',' ').capitalize()`; stores prompt/confirmation_prompt/prompt_required/hide_input; `_flag_needs_value = prompt is not None and not prompt_required`.
- `core.py:Option.consume_value` calls `Parameter.consume_value`, then prompts (source=`ParameterSource.PROMPT`) when (a) value is `FLAG_NEEDS_VALUE` sentinel (bare `--opt`), or (b) value UNSET/source DEFAULT_MAP-or-lower, and `(required or prompt_required)`; both skipped if `ctx.resilient_parsing`.
- `core.py:Option.prompt_for_value`: computes `get_default` first; bool flag -> `termui.confirm`; else `termui.prompt(default, type=self.type, hide_input, show_choices, confirmation_prompt, value_proc=lambda x: self.process_value(ctx, x))`. So validation errors (UsageError) re-loop inside prompt.
- `termui.py:prompt`: builds text with `_build_prompt`; inner `prompt_func` picks `hidden_prompt_func if hide_input else visible_prompt_func`; handles confirmation ("Repeat for confirmation", mismatch -> retry), masks value in errors via `_mask_hidden_input`, KeyboardInterrupt/EOFError -> `Abort`.
- `termui.py:hidden_prompt_func` lazily imports getpass -> `getpass.getpass`; `visible_prompt_func = input`. `_readline_prompt` wraps the call (strips ANSI, err redirect); `confirm` also uses it.
